sql: SELECT json_build_object('msgs', (SELECT json_agg(m ORDER BY m.timestamp) FROM (SELECT m.timestamp, m.from_me, m.message_type, m.metadata->>'source' AS src, left(m.content, 700) AS txt FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.contact_phone LIKE '%11963539901%' ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC LIMIT 30) m), 'conv', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('bot_step', c.bot_step, 'handoff', c.bot_data->'ai_handoff', 'mes', c.bot_data->'mes', 'data_festa', c.bot_data->'data_festa', 'convidados', c.bot_data->'convidados', 'periodo', c.bot_data->'periodo')) FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.contact_phone LIKE '%11963539901%'), 'regra_degustacao', (SELECT json_agg(substring(s.extra_instructions from greatest(1, position('egusta' in s.extra_instructions) - 300) for 900)) FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.extra_instructions ILIKE '%degusta%'), 'info_degustacao', (SELECT json_agg(substring(s.buffet_info from greatest(1, position('egusta' in s.buffet_info) - 300) for 900)) FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.buffet_info ILIKE '%degusta%')) AS r
